subject.title: ci(release): add plugin npm artifact preflight

question: Should this release-workflow change require one actual `preflight_only` dispatch before merge, or is the maintainer-authored package proof plus exact-head tests sufficient?
rationale: No concrete patch defect was found, but the green proof-policy job skipped evidence validation for the member author and no artifact produced by the new workflow route is linked.

options.title: Require one real dispatch
options.body: Run the non-mutating route and inspect the staging manifest, Actions digest, and final v2 evidence artifact before merge.

options.title: Accept equivalent proof
options.body: Accept the manual package hash, byte-equivalence claim, exact-head checks, contract tests, and release-owner review.

recommendation.title: Require one real dispatch
recommendation.body: Run the non-mutating route and inspect the staging manifest, Actions digest, and final v2 evidence artifact before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent hardening history and supplied the package proof for this workflow change.
